messages:
Anita (on-call): getting pages — p99 spike in eu-west-3, streaming clients reporting stalls and partial responses
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — Severity=SEV2 — routing::hotshard-misroute — paged to Anita, Marcus, Robin
Anita (on-call): initial triage: p95 up x3, p99 up x6 over baseline. Errors low, but streaming sessions saw stalled chunks for ~10-20s. No config rollouts in the last hour per deploy bot.
Marcus (SRE): seeing routing table churn + many flow handoffs to a single shard pool in eu-west-3. Hot partition count jumped from 2 -> 14 at 08:12 UTC
Robin (Infra): telemetry shows many requests pinned to shard-id=shard-17 on balancer euw3-lb-02. Weight for shard-17 is unexpectedly high (0.83). Could be a policy bug in weight recompute.
Anita (on-call): customer impact? Leah?
Leah (CS): CC @customers impacted: two streaming customers reported degraded UX (buffering, reconnects). One large customer reported timeouts on long-running streams — flagged as priority.
Marcus (SRE): digging into router logs, sample: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:12:33Z] router[euw3]: route decision for conn=abc123 -> shard-17 (weight=0.830) policy_eval=sticky_affinity priority=normal
[2026-03-15T08:12:33Z] router[euw3]: kv_cache_miss prefix_len=512 client=stream-collector
```
Seems affinity keys being amplified by a recent seed change; many ephemeral keys mapping to same logical bucket.
Dev-Eng-Dow: I deployed a small rollout to routing-policy v2 at 07:58 — it included an optimization for prefer_local that changed hash seeding. Rolling back now?
Anita (on-call): action list: 1) mitigate live (fallback), 2) confirm rollback, 3) assess customer impact & notify. Marcus/Robin you take 1/2.
Robin (Infra): live mitigation = force-deprioritize shard-17 across euw3 and spin up extra fallback pool. Running command to set weight=0.0 for shard-17 on euw3-lb-02: 
```
curl -XPOST "https://ops-api.internal/balancer/euw3-lb-02/weights" -d '{"shard_id":"shard-17","weight":0.0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
Applying to all nodes now.
Marcus (SRE): also increasing fallback pool cap and enabling eager-fallback for streaming route config: 
```
route.streaming.eager_fallback=true
route.streaming.fallback_pool.size=20
```
Marcus (SRE): rolling back routing-policy v2 to v1 on control plane to undo seed change. Patch rolled back at 08:20 UTC by Dow.
Dev-Eng-Dow: rollback completed, control-plane confirms policy set -> v1. Waiting for propagation ~30s.
Anita (on-call): telemetry — p99 trending down but still ~2.5x baseline. Are we seeing reconnect storms?
Marcus (SRE): yes transient reconnect spike as clients drained from shard-17 -> fallback; reconnects peaked at 08:23 for ~40s. Streaming stalls cleared for most sessions after 08:26.
Leah (CS): notified affected customers with an acknowledgement. ETA for full normalization?
Robin (Infra): lb weight change propagated across nodes by 08:22, rates redistributed. KV/prefix cache heat is still cold for the fallback pool — expect residual tail for ~10-15 minutes as caches warm and prefix KVs repopulate.
Anita (on-call): customer notify: "We're mitigating a routing imbalance causing streaming stalls in eu-west-3. We've applied an emergency fallback and rolled back a recent routing policy change. Expect residual tail latency while caches warm. We'll update in 15 minutes."
PagerDuty-bot: Incident updated — runbook step 3 (notify exec) completed by Anita
Marcus (SRE): follow-up tasks: 1) root cause: investigate why weight recompute boosted shard-17 (hash seeding + affinity amplification), 2) add guardrails to prevent >0.5 weighting without manual approval, 3) add telemetry alert for sudden shard-weight deltas >0.25 in 1m.
Dev-Eng-Dow: opened PR with fix to seed derivation and added unit tests. Will run canary on staging.
Robin (Infra): creating playbook entry for streaming-fallback (commands we used, expected cache warm durations, metrics to watch).
Leah (CS): collecting customer logs for postmortem, will coordinate with SRE for remediation credit where appropriate.
Anita (on-call): last checks: p95 ~1.2x baseline, p99 ~1.5x baseline and trending down. I'll keep this thread open until p99 <1.2x for 30m. Great work team. :thumbsup:
